en-US.description: Cross-platform desktop client for multi-engine AI coding assistants
en-US.longDescription: Polaris is a cross-platform desktop application built with Tauri 2.x, providing a unified graphical interface for multiple AI coding CLI tools. It supports OpenAI Codex CLI, Claude Code CLI, and OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling AI-assisted programming without the command line.

zh-CN.description: 多引擎 AI 编程助手的跨平台桌面客户端
zh-CN.longDescription: Polaris 是一款基于 Tauri 2.x 构建的跨平台桌面应用，为多种 AI 编程 CLI 工具提供统一的图形化操作界面。支持 OpenAI Codex CLI、Claude Code CLI 和 OpenAI 兼容 API 三种引擎，让你无需命令行也能享受 AI 辅助编程的体验。
